abstract: Undifferentiated mouse teratocarcinoma cells were cocultivated with differentiated mouse endoderm cells in order to study the possible induction of teratocarcinoma cell differentiation. A difference in DNA content between the two cell types was experimentally introduced to enable the reisolation of the teratocarcinoma cells after cocultivation. Pseudotetraploid (2s) endoderm cell lines were produced from pseudodiploid (1s) cells by treatment of these cells with cytochalasin B and flow sorting of tetraploid cells, using Hoechst 33342 as a viable DNA stain, with subsequent cloning of sorted single cells. In model experiments, where mixtures of 1s teratocarcinoma and 2s endoderm cells were stained with Hoechst 33342, the teratocarcinoma cells could be reisolated with a purity of about 97%. After a cocultivation period of 24 days viable teratocarcinoma cells could be isolated from the cocultivation mixture with a purity of 95%. Two dimensional analysis of the protein pattern of these cells indicated that cocultivation did not induce a differentiated (endoderm) pattern. Therefore according to this analysis the teratocarcinoma cells were not induced to differentiate during a 24 day cocultivation period. The method described offers excellent possibilities for studying cell-cell interaction in vitro.
abstract_ja: 未分化のマウス奇形癌細胞を、分化したマウス内胚葉細胞と共培養し、奇形癌細胞の分化誘導の可能性を検討した。両細胞型のDNA含量に人為的な差を導入し、共培養後に奇形癌細胞を再単離できるようにした。シトカラシンBで処理して偽二倍体(1s)の内胚葉細胞から偽四倍体(2s)の内胚葉細胞株を作製し、四倍体細胞をフローソーティングで選別した後、単一細胞をクローン化した。Hoechst 33342を生細胞のDNA染色色素として用いた。1s奇形癌細胞と2s内胚葉細胞の混合物をモデル実験として染色したところ、奇形癌細胞を約97%の純度で再単離できた。24日間の共培養後にも、混合培養物から生存する奇形癌細胞を95%の純度で単離できた。タンパク質パターンの二次元解析では、共培養によって内胚葉型のパターンは誘導されなかった。したがって、この解析によれば、奇形癌細胞は24日間の共培養期間中に分化を誘導されなかった。本法は、in vitroでの細胞間相互作用の研究に有用な可能性を持つ。
